evidence.root_cause_narrative: The public config.json of every released Qwen/Qwen3.5-* checkpoint (0.8B / 2B / 4B / 9B / 27B / 35B-A3B) reports vision_config.deepstack_visual_indexes = []. Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration (the superclass of Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration) initialises self.deepstack_visual_indexes from this list, so num_deepstack_embeddings = 0. In general_mm_embed_routine, deepstack_embedding_shape becomes (num_tokens, hidden_size * 0) = (num_tokens, 0). Qwen3_5ForCausalLM.forward gates DeepStack on input_deepstack_embeds is not None and input_deepstack_embeds.numel() > 0, so the add_ branch is trivially skipped on every request. Consequently the zero-DeepStack ablation is a no-op on this model, not because the branch instrumentation misfires (it fires 111 times per arm and correctly reports numel=0), but because there is nothing to zero.
